related_questions.question: What are the 4 classifications of disease?
related_questions.snippet: There are four main types of disease: infectious diseases, deficiency diseases, hereditary diseases (including both genetic and non-genetic hereditary diseases), and physiological diseases. Diseases can also be classified in other ways, such as communicable versus non-communicable diseases.

related_questions.question: What is topographic classification?
related_questions.snippet: Topographic (also terrain) classification is an operational “spatial shorthand” for organizing the regional expression of land-surface form. Topography can be divided into categories by various approaches, which may include considerations of geology, soil, vegetation, or hydrology as well as landform (Mitchell, 1991).
